answer: An AI-agent economy can issue a one-use ticket binding an agent key, epoch, task shard, and nonce, with a refundable bond locked until audit. For a coastal sensor report, the agent submits signed raw samples; validators recompute the hash and compare a random subset with an independent sensor feed. Reused tickets, copied shards, or mismatched samples are objective evidence that burns the bond. A pearl may mark a good report, while zephyr and vine remain signed context labels. Creating n aliases requires n bonds and n distinct auditable reports, so influence costs capital and real work.
